high_level_description: This image captures a serene beach scene at sunset. The sky is painted with hues of orange and pink, transitioning into a darker blue as it meets the horizon. The sun appears to be setting behind an island or landmass in the distance, casting a warm glow over the water. In the foreground, a person is sitting on a rocky outcrop near the shoreline. They are dressed in a white sleeveless top and dark pants, with their legs crossed and hands resting on their knees. Their posture suggests they are relaxed and enjoying the peaceful moment.
